metaDescription: Order custom biking personal care items for your team. Sunscreen, lip balm, and more from Perfect Imprints. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Biking personal care items are designed for cyclists who need compact, sweat-resistant products that fit in a jersey pocket or saddlebag. From SPF lip balms to mini sunscreens, these items help your team stay protected on long rides. Decoration options include pad printing or labels for a clean, professional look that stands out at group rides or corporate cycling events.
